question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**excess**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank 4 will imply how the advertisers have caused us want more than our needs.**
 
• **Thus, the correct word to fill blank 4 is "excess."**
 
 
• "Excess" means more than what is necessary or required.(अधिकता)
 
 
• Examples of usage: "There was an excess of food at the party" or "The company had an excess of inventory".
 
 
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "unneeded", means not required or necessary.(अनावश्यक)
 
• Option 3, "redundant", means unnecessary repetition or duplication.(अनावश्यक)
 
• Option 4, "ample", means enough or more than enough.(प्रचुर)
